facts.fact: 新德里之行顺利：BUTTONFLY 的人 MYPLACEORYOURS 准时到 Le Méridien 的 eau de Monsoon 餐厅吃午饭，带着一份很体面的掩护提案。
facts.anchor: showed up for lunch at Le Méridien’s eau de Monsoon restaurant right on time and with a very respectable cover proposal

facts.fact: 当晚 Nero 酒吧里，那位酒店老板是 Brahmin（婆罗门），最爱讲种姓制度的笑话，边讲边摆弄一只金色打火机。
facts.anchor: His best jokes were about India’s caste system, probably because, as a Brahmin, he sat on top of the heap

facts.fact: KRAY 为了给美国政府省点钱，从新德里经 Agra 坐火车三等座去 Varanasi。
facts.anchor: KRAY rode the train from New Delhi to Varanasi via Agra, traveling Third Class to save the U.S. government

facts.fact: KRAY 用从德里买的 OSS 短剑复制品去撬卡死的车窗，刀刃断成两半。
facts.anchor: the blade of his stiletto snaps in half

facts.fact: 破冰后，有乘客递给 KRAY 一张用塑料包着的 chapati，他接过来吃了，又拿出开心果分给众人。
facts.anchor: someone hands KRAY a chapati wrapped in plastic, and he takes it

facts.fact: 那张 chapati 让他连病三天，像一艘搁浅的破船；后来靠几天 Cipro 和瓶装水才缓过来。
facts.anchor: he was sick through three straight days of feeling like a human shipwreck

facts.fact: 蓝西装男子索回 24K 金打火机后转身离开，又叫出 KRAY 的真名 Mr. Nick。
出发去加德满都前夜，KRAY 心神不宁，把 KANDINSKY 织的灰色 v 领突击队毛衣忘在衣柜顶层。
facts.anchor: he forgot KANDINSKY’s grey v-neck commando sweater on the top shelf in the wardrobe
